bugs.name: Milestone card title and repository label overlap at mobile viewport width
bugs.summary: At a 390 × 844 viewport, the first listed open milestone's long title visibly overlaps the repository label on its card, making both fields difficult to read.
bugs.expected: The milestone title and repository label shown as separate card fields remain visually distinct and readable at 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
bugs.actual: On the global Milestones overview, the long title on a listed open milestone wraps over the repository label. The overlap remained visible in a fresh observation after waiting five seconds.
reproSteps: Sign in as momentic-admin using the fixture credentials.
Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
Open the global Milestones overview at /milestones.
Inspect an open milestone with a long title and the momentic-admin/field-notes repository label.
Observe that the title overlaps the repository label; wait five seconds and confirm the overlap persists.

bugs.name: Global Milestones Sort menu is clipped at mobile viewport width
bugs.summary: At a 390×844 viewport, the global Milestones Sort menu extends past the right edge and persistently clips several option labels, including after closing and reopening it.
bugs.expected: All sort option labels should be fully visible and readable within the 390-pixel mobile viewport so users can distinguish the available sort modes.
bugs.actual: The menu extends beyond the viewport's right edge. Several labels are cut off (visible portions include “Nearest d”, “Farthest d”, “Least com”, “Most com”, “Most issu”, and “Least issu”); only “Name” fits. The clipping remained after closing and reopening the menu and after waiting for the page to settle.
reproSteps: Sign in as momentic-admin using the fixture credentials.
Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
Open the global Milestones overview at /milestones.
Click Sort next to Search.
Observe that the menu extends beyond the right edge and clips the option labels. Close and reopen it to confirm the clipping persists.

reviewedVariants.name: Projects Sort menu clips option labels offscreen on mobile
reviewedVariants.summary: At 390×844 on the authenticated momentic-admin Projects page, the Sort menu persistently extends past the viewport’s right edge, visibly truncating its option labels. Reopening after a reload reproduced the same clipping; selecting an option closed the menu and updated the list.
reviewedVariants.expected: The sort choices shown by the Projects page should be fully visible in the opened menu at the requested mobile viewport so their displayed names can be read when choosing a sort order.
reviewedVariants.actual: At 390×844, the menu opened past the right edge: “Recently updated” and “Least recently updated” were visibly truncated. The clipping persisted for over six seconds and reproduced after reloading and reopening the menu. Selecting “Recently updated” closed the menu and updated the project list.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 390×844 CSS pixels before navigation.
Authenticate as the owner-level momentic-admin profile using the provided saved session.
Navigate to /momentic-admin/-/projects.

Click the Sort control above the project list. The menu extends beyond the right edge, truncating “Recently updated” and “Least recently updated”; wait for the menu to settle and observe that it remains clipped.
Reload the same Projects URL and open Sort again. The same clipping remains visible.
For terminal-state verification, select “Recently updated.” The menu closes and the list updates; no project records are modified.

reviewedVariants.name: Subscriptions Sort menu clips option labels at 768px viewport
reviewedVariants.summary: The Subscriptions Sort menu reproducibly extends past the 768px viewport edge, clipping the ends of its option labels; selecting Recently updated still sorts the list.
reviewedVariants.expected: With Open and Issues selected, the Sort menu's option labels, including Recently updated and Most comments, should be fully visible and readable within the 768px viewport.
reviewedVariants.actual: The opened Sort menu extends beyond the right edge of the viewport, visibly truncating several option labels. Reopening reproduced the clipping; selecting Recently updated closed the menu and updated the list.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 768×1024 CSS pixels and start signed in as an Admin using the provided saved authentication state.
Navigate to /notifications.
Open Subscriptions, select Open in the status control, then open Type and select Issues. Existing issue subscriptions are present; no fixture creation is needed.
Open Sort on the subscriptions list at /notifications/subscriptions?sort=&state=open&issueType=issues&labels= . Observe the option text clipped at the viewport's right edge.
Close and reopen Sort to confirm the clipping recurs, then select Recently updated and verify the menu closes and the subscription list changes.

reviewedVariants.name: Global Issues Sort menu clips option labels at 768px viewport
reviewedVariants.summary: At 768×1024, the global Issues Sort menu repeatedly extends past the viewport edge and visibly clips its option labels, including after waiting and refreshing.
reviewedVariants.expected: The Sort menu's option labels remain within the viewport and are fully readable.
reviewedVariants.actual: The open menu extends beyond the right edge of the 768px viewport, visibly cutting off the ends of multiple option labels. The clipping remained after five seconds and reproduced after refreshing and reopening the menu.
reproSteps: Load the supplied saved authentication state to access the site as an authorized admin; no credentials were entered during this run.
Set the browser viewport to 768×1024.
Navigate to /issues.
Click the Sort control at the right end of the global Issues filter row.
Observe the clipped option labels; wait five seconds, refresh the page, and reopen Sort. The labels remain clipped.

bugs.name: Closing milestone from its detail opens an empty list
bugs.summary: The Close control on a milestone detail page successfully closes the milestone but redirects with state=close instead of state=closed, leaving an empty milestone list.
bugs.expected: After closing a milestone, navigate to the Closed milestones list containing the newly closed milestone.
bugs.actual: Close redirects to /milestones?state=close. The page shows 0 Open and 1 Closed, but no milestone row. Clicking 1 Closed navigates with state=closed and displays the milestone. Reopened and repeated with the same result.
reproSteps: Sign in as owner and open an open milestone's detail page (tested bugbash-org/bugbash-org-repo/milestone/3, Org global milestone).
Click Close on the detail page.
Observe the redirect to the repository's /milestones?state=close and empty results despite the Closed count increasing.
Click the Closed count.
Observe state=closed in the URL and the newly closed milestone displayed.
Reopen from the list and repeat Close from the detail page to reproduce.

bugs.name: Whitespace-only project, milestone, and label names are accepted
bugs.summary: Required name fields accept spaces and persist visually nameless projects, milestones and labels.
bugs.expected: Reject required names that are blank after trimming and ask for a visible name.
bugs.actual: Submitting spaces as the name creates and persists projects, milestones and labels whose names render blank. Label selectors consequently contain an unnamed option.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /momentic-admin/-/projects; click New project.
Enter three spaces in Title and create the project. Reload the project list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/milestones/new; enter three spaces in Title and create the milestone. Inspect the milestone list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/labels; click New label, enter three spaces in Name, and create the label. Inspect the label list and an issue's Labels selector.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Only the core failure described in this reference is accepted; the stronger original subclaims remain unestablished.
